summary: The customer called in extreme anger demanding to close their account immediately due to being charged for an unused internet line for three months. The agent attempted to check the bill but was cut off by the customer refusing further checks and insisting on immediate cancellation. The agent agreed to process the cancellation immediately and send a confirmation message, after which the customer ended the call.

evidence.text: رح ألغي الحساب حالا وأبعثلك رسالة تأكيد
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Cancel the account immediately and send a confirmation message to the customer.

evidence.text: انا اسف على سماع ذلك يا أستاذ، ممكن أعرف السبب لو سمحت عشان أقدر أساعدك بالشكل المناسب؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent remained calm and professional despite the customer's aggressive and abusive language.

evidence.text: أنا فاهم غضبك يا استاذ، اعطيني شوي أشيك على الفاتورة، بس أرجو منك...
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's anger and apologized for their experience, though was cut off before fully developing empathy.

evidence.text: حاضر يا أستاذ، طلبك قيد التنفيذ، رح ألغي الحساب حالا وأبعثلك رسالة تأكيد
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent promptly accepted the customer's cancellation request and promised to execute it.

evidence.text: أهلاً بك في خدمة العملاء، معك رامي، كيف أستطيع مساعدتك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent's opening and communication throughout were clear and articulate.

evidence.text: في شي ثاني أقدر أخدمك فيه؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent attempted a standard closure question, but the call ended abruptly by the customer before a proper final sign-off.
The agent intended to check the bill for accuracy, but was prevented by the customer from investigating further.

evidence.text: رح ألغي الحساب حالا وأبعثلك رسالة تأكيد
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed the customer's direct instruction to cancel, though standard retention/investigation procedures were bypassed due to customer hostility.

quote.text: السبب إنكم نصابين! فاتحين علي خط انترنت ما بستخدمه وبتاخدوا مني مصاريف على الفاضي من ثلاث شهور!

quote.text: لا تفهمني ولا أشيك! أنا لا بدي أشيك ولا بدي نت تبعكم، بدي تلغي هذا الخط حالاً اليوم قبل بكره!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: بس تخلصني منكم بكون أكبر خدمة! مع السلامة!
